e) Spokesman for SEWRPC stating they supported the proposed highway improvement and that it is in accord with their long range transportation system development plans. c) Milwaukee School Board
d) 49
e) Spokesman for School Board stated that their policy was neither to endorse nor condemn the proposed improvement and that the Garland School site would not be affected but that the school district would. Stated that students living in the area to be acquired for General Mitchell Field cargo area would be affected.
